title: Lab - Kustomize directories
description: Compose a project from nested directories.
scenario: Compose a project from nested directories. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Root
tasks.instructions: Write a root kustomization.yaml that includes the api and db directories.

tasks.title: Task 2 - Sub
tasks.instructions: Give each sub-directory its own kustomization.yaml listing its manifests.

tasks.title: Task 3 - Verify
tasks.instructions: Confirm both the api and db objects were created from one apply.
